name_reason: Name follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: composites the battle map's tile layer (plus chapter-aware animated/parallax background) onto a destination buffer. Accurately reflects purpose and body; no Ghidra address residue.
purpose: First rendering pass of the battle frame compositor: draw the chapter-aware animated/parallax background then the per-tile map layer into the render workspace.
logic_summary: Tick latch: if BIOS tick (signed word @0x46C) changed, toggle bg_anim_flip_flag and latch tick. Chapter dispatch on current_chapter_id for the background source: animated chapters (9,0x18,0x19,0x1C,0x1D) advance a 0..15 per-row-offset shimmer (animated_bg_buffer, stride 0x140); extra-wide parallax chapters (0x11,0x15,0x16,0x1B) compute a scrolled offset into static_bg_buffer (stride 0x1CE for 0x11/0x1B else 0x198); chapter 0x17 auto-scrolls the text-screen bg (static_bg_buffer, stride 0x138); any other chapter skips the bg blit. If a source resolved, fd2_blit_rectangle copies the 312x192 (0x138 x 0xC0) visible area. Tile-anim sub-counter: when forced_tile_anim_frame == -1 free-run advance once per 3 BIOS ticks wrapping at 0x14, else lock to forced value; derive palette_remap = tile_anim_table_base + *(tile_anim_table_base+6+phase_lookup[counter]*4). Per-tile double loop (n_rows x n_cols): read tile meta from tile_map_ptr, tile_id = word & 0x3FF, look up attr flags; flag 0x08 adds flip_flag*2, 0x10 adds ambient_palette_idx/2, 0x04 adds flip_flag; resolve sprite from scene_snapshot; meta byte (offset 7 from row base) == -1 -> passthrough blit, else palette-remap blit.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_composite_battle_tile_map(uint32 dst_buf, uint32 dst_stride, uint32 n_cols, uint32 n_rows, uint32 win_origin_x, uint32 win_origin_y)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Render workspace base address (Stack[0x4]). Used as the destination row base for tile blits and the bg blit dst offset.
params.reason: Ghidra decompiler scrambled the param order; live name param_1 is a generic placeholder. True ABI slot 0 is the destination workspace base (src already names it dst_buf).

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Destination/workspace pitch (Stack[0x8]); callers pass 456 (0x1C8). Used as blit stride and pDst_row = dst_buf + row*stride*0x18.
params.reason: param_2 is a generic placeholder; true ABI slot 1 is the destination stride (src already names it dst_stride).

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Per-row tile count (Stack[0xC]); callers pass 13 (0xD). Inner-loop bound (col_iter < n_cols).
params.reason: param_3 is a generic placeholder; true ABI slot 2 is the inner-loop tile-column count (src already names it n_cols).

params.name: dst_buf
params.semantics: Tile-row count (Stack[0x10]); callers pass 8. Outer-loop bound (row_iter < n_rows).
params.reason: Ghidra mislabeled this slot dst_buf, but the true ABI slot 3 is the outer-loop row count. Live Ghidra name is wrong (scrambled order); correct semantic name is n_rows.

params.name: dst_stride
params.semantics: Battle view window origin tile X (Stack[0x14]). Used in tile-meta index ((row+win_origin_y)*map_width + win_origin_x) and parallax offset win_origin_x*3.
params.reason: Ghidra mislabeled this slot dst_stride; the true ABI slot 4 is the view-window origin X. Correct semantic name is win_origin_x.

params.name: n_cols
params.semantics: Battle view window origin tile Y (Stack[0x18]). Used in tile-meta index ((row+win_origin_y)*map_width) and parallax offset win_origin_y*stride*2.
params.reason: Ghidra mislabeled this slot n_cols; the true ABI slot 5 is the view-window origin Y. Correct semantic name is win_origin_y.

returns.semantics: No return value (no EAX-after-CALL is consumed by any caller).
